Important note: we've seen forwarded .ics files lose the TZID on some mail clients which causes "floating" times in Google Calendar (invite shows correct hour but in other timezones it shifts). To avoid that, we'll: 
- create the invite with DTSTART/DTEND in UTC (no floating TZ),
- include a VTIMEZONE block for common timezones, and
- ask you to accept from the calendar UI rather than forwarding.

I'll attach an .ics and the MAP for the demo. Priya, Connor — FYI in case we need to create a UTC-anchored invite from our side.

- Sent the invite from our hosted calendar (not as a forwarded attachment) so Google Calendar will record the timezone properly.
- Attached the new ICS here for your records.
